resources.string: No alarms yet — tap + to add one.
Exact alarms are disabled. Open system settings to allow them.
Samsung One UI may delay alarms when the app is in deep sleep. Allow GT Alarm to ignore battery optimizations so it always rings on time.

Android doesn\'t have a single setting called \"default alarm app\". When you ask Google Assistant to set an alarm, the system either uses an app you\'ve picked before, or shows a chooser the first time. Choosing GT Alarm and tapping \"Always\" makes it the default thereafter.
GT Alarm is the default alarm app on this device.
Multiple alarm apps are installed. The next time you say \"Hey Google, set an alarm\", Android will show a chooser — pick GT Alarm and tap Always.
%1$s is currently the default. Use the steps for your phone brand below to switch.
No alarm app is registered on this device. Try reinstalling GT Alarm.
If a different app got set as default by mistake: Settings → Apps → that app → Open by default → Clear defaults.

Authorize Wear Engine access so alarms can ring on a Huawei Sports Watch / GT-series device that is already paired through Huawei Health. Requires the Huawei Health app; nothing happens on devices without it.

Pixel ships with the Google Clock app handling alarm voice commands. The first time you say \"Hey Google, set an alarm\", Android may show a chooser if both apps qualify — pick GT Alarm and tap Always. To swap later, open Settings → Apps → Google Clock → Open by default → Clear defaults, then voice-trigger again and pick GT Alarm.

Galaxy phones come pre-installed with Samsung Clock. One UI doesn\'t expose a \"default alarm app\" setting — instead, Google Assistant will show a chooser the first time it fires \"set alarm\" and both apps qualify. Pick GT Alarm + tap Always. Bixby may not honor third-party clocks. Make sure GT Alarm is on the battery-optimization exempt list (the card on the alarm list links to that setting) — One UI deep-sleep can otherwise delay alarms.

MIUI Clock is the system default. Voice-set alarms via Google Assistant will trigger a chooser the first time — pick GT Alarm + Always. Note that third-party alarm apps may not show the alarm-clock icon in the status bar (a HyperOS limitation). Also visit GT Alarm\'s battery card; MIUI\'s autostart and background limits are aggressive and can suppress alarms otherwise.

OxygenOS uses the OnePlus Clock by default. The first \"Hey Google, set an alarm\" should show a chooser — pick GT Alarm + tap Always. Visit the battery optimization card on the alarm list; OxygenOS deep-sleep can delay alarms unless GT Alarm is exempted.

Huawei phones without Google Mobile Services (most models since 2020) don\'t run Google Assistant — voice-set won\'t work via the GT Alarm intent. Native assistants (Celia, Bixby) typically don\'t honor third-party alarm apps. If you have a GMS-installed Huawei (older models), follow the Pixel / stock Android steps.

Most Android phones use the system Clock app by default. When Google Assistant fires \"set an alarm\", the system shows a chooser if multiple apps can handle it — pick GT Alarm and tap Always. The system remembers the choice per-intent.
